rationale: Build, blood pressure, lipids, A1c, family history, occupation, driving, liver and financials all carry zero debits. Tobacco quit within the last five years adds 25. Private aviation refers to judgement; with no referral available I applied the manual's own fallback and rated it as a hazardous avocation at 50, noting the pilot's substantial experience and no aerobatics. Total 75 debits reads Table 2. Precedents confirm the tobacco charge but offer no aviation guidance.
